activation_rule: No semantic/report test may execute until the report-transition structural branch has been fixed under the semantic_report_dissociation_design/discovery_report_transition_multiresolution_fit lineage and any held-out structural-transfer decisions required by that branch have been prespecified.
global_boundaries: No emotion/report value may influence any EEG preprocessing, K choice, centroid, support threshold, or structural gate.
No family may be renamed from Discovery behavior and then treated as having that meaning in held-out splits.
The dataset contains joy/inspiration/tenderness/sadness/fear/disgust/neutral categories; it does not contain anger as a nominal category.
The report-transition hypothesis concerns neural transformation around evaluation/report generation, not truthfulness of the participant.
Physiology remains outside the primary structural_replication semantic program unless a separately prespecified synchronized representation becomes available.
heldout_behavior_rule: Before Validation or Confirmation behavior is opened, a separate lineage/specification must materialize authoritative held-out behavioral/category/context rows from the same prespecified split and corrected event/stimulus lineage. Discovery-selected report subsets, thresholds, family names, or semantic labels are forbidden.

A1_nominal_category_family_mapping.cross_split_requirement: the same prespecified family IDs and same metrics are reported separately in Discovery, Validation, and Confirmation; no split-specific relabeling or category regrouping
A1_nominal_category_family_mapping.interpretation: weak/many-to-many mapping is evidence of poor alignment between the human category taxonomy and the neural partition, but non-significance alone is not proof that a label is wrong
A1_nominal_category_family_mapping.null: 10000 within-participant permutations of family labels preserving each participant's family counts
primary_metrics: participant-balanced normalized mutual information between emotion_category and family
participant-balanced Cramer's V between emotion_category and family

A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.baseline: participant-safe nuisance terms only: context + acquisition_fraction + acquisition_fraction_squared
A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.dimension_followups: individual report effects are secondary and only interpreted after the parent 10D test; Holm within the 10 reports
A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.model: LOPO multinomial logistic regression with fixed L2 regularization grid selected inside training participants only
A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.null: 1000 within-participant permutations of the complete 10-report row vector preserving report covariance
A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.predictor: all 10 reports jointly; no post-hoc subset selection
A2_full_report_profile_family_mapping.primary_statistic: participant-balanced held-out balanced-accuracy improvement over baseline

hypothesis_A_label_mismatch.multiplicity: Holm across the six parent tests A1/A2 x K=2,3,4 within each split; held-out replication is evaluated with the exact same parent definitions
hypothesis_A_label_mismatch.question: Do human nominal emotion labels and 10-dimensional subjective reports map cleanly to the replicated stimulus-only neural partitions, or are the relations many-to-many?
hypothesis_A_label_mismatch.semantic_naming_rule: even a significant association does not rename a family automatically; a family may only receive a semantic label if the mapping is strong, specific, directionally stable across held-out splits, and a later naming rule has been separately prespecified

hypothesis_B_report_transition.B0_outcome_free_structure_first: report-transition structure must be discovered/fixed without behavior under the RT policy above

metrics: ARI/NMI between experience and report-transition discrete resolutions when available
participant-balanced contingency and conditional occupancy matrices
continuous canonical correlation is forbidden unless separately prespecified

B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.estimator: multivariate ridge; alpha grid [1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10,100,1000,10000] selected inside training participants only
B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.interpretation: positive support means rating/report-stage neural transformation contains information about the eventual report beyond the stimulus-only representation. It does NOT establish distortion, dishonesty, conscious editing, suppression, or exaggeration.
B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.null: 1000 within-participant permutations of the complete 10-report row vector, preserving covariance among reports
B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.primary_statistic: participant-balanced held-out multivariate SSE reduction / R2 improvement of M2 over M1
B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.secondary: dimension-specific Delta-R2 for the 10 reports, gated by the parent global test and Holm-corrected across reports
B2_incremental_report_mapping_primary.training_only_target_preprocessing: for each report dimension, standardize using training participants only; no test-participant outcome centering/calibration

B3_discrete_transition_family_report_map.activation: only if one or more report-transition K are structurally replicated
B3_discrete_transition_family_report_map.method: apply the same 10D family-report mapping framework to each replicated transition K; no K is chosen based on report strength

hypothesis_B_report_transition.question: Does stimulus_late -> rating_early neural transformation carry report-related information beyond the already replicated stimulus-only experience representation?
